question: Who has been appointed as a full-time member of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister of India in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Sanjeev Sanyal__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sanjeev Sanyal**

 
 
• **Sanjeev Sanyal** has been appointed as a full-time member of the** Economic Advisory Council** to the Prime Minister of India in** February 2022**.
 
• An economist and popular historian from India is named** Sanjeev Sanyal**. He has assisted in the creation of six versions of the** Economic Survey of India** since its inception in **2017**,
 
• He is a member of the **Economic Advisory Council **to the** Prime Minister of India**. Several works on Indian history that **Sanyal **has published have received mixed reviews.
 
• **Sanyal **champions the application of the Complex Adaptive Systems paradigm to economic concerns and hails the 1991 liberalisation reforms as the beginning of the** Indian Renaissance**
 
 
 
• **Sanyal **asserts that **Ashoka **did not become a Buddhist because of sorrow for the** Kalinga War** but rather as a result of political pressure from the **Jains**.
 
• **Sanyal **emphasises the urgent necessity for a** post-socialist** understanding of history and places the blame for **Ashoka's **elevation to the status of **"great king"** squarely on the** Nehruvian ambition**.
 
• **Sanyal's **work on urban challenges earned him an Eisenhower Fellowship in **2007**. He received the World Economic Forum's** Young Global Leader award in 2010**.
